summary: The Backrooms is a persistent multiplayer survival RPG spanning Level 0, a social hub and lore destinations, with a solo ephemeral tutorial. Shared player behaviors and place simulations combine authored scenes with generated spaces; player saves hold progression, gear, quests and homes. Level 31 is a modular roller rink whose versioned sim builds the venue shell and furnishings, while zone builders dress its shops and activity areas.
places: places/main (3D) - Level 0/Lobby maze; sim lays ecology, routes, landmarks, Christmas Area and stair anomalies.
places/bonus (3D) - shared vaporwave mall with simulated staff, shops, directory, arcade, payphones and player-home kiosk.
places/intake + places/tutorial0 (3D; tutorial0 solo ephemeral) - character creation/waking and staged tutorial route; HALOGEN handoff seeds Dina's lead.
places/level01 (3D) - Zenith Station: station, breach, doors, bots, hazards and recorder quest.

places/level1, places/level2, places/level02, places/level21, places/level3, places/gamma (3D) - Habitable Zone/M.E.G. camp, Pipe Dreams, Level 0.2, Locked, Electrical Station and Base Gamma; Level 2's plywood rink door crosses to Level 31.

places/level31 (3D; Roller Rink) - rink/cinema/DJ booth with arcade, food court, skate rental and gift counter; versioned sim adds edge lockers, benches and bins, cinema seats and curtains, and an employee-only Level 70 door casing.

places/level4, places/level5, places/level6, places/level7, places/level10, places/level26, places/level27 (3D) - Office, Hotel, drowned house, sea/Fort Surrender and deeper destinations; Level 5 rooms are permanent player homes, Level 26 …
places/level11, places/level12, places/level13, places/testlab, places/spamton and other configured places (3D) - Infinite City, Matrix/Floor 283, authored tests and additional lore destinations.
roots: world.config.yaml + templates/player.js - multiplayer entry, camera/player setup, ordered behaviors and input mappings; config selects shared lighting.
places/<place>/config.yaml + cells/*.scene + sim.js - local configuration, authored placements and generated/ticked simulation.
scripts/main-menu.js + main-menu-ui.js + intake/tutorial scripts - title, creation, arrival, tutorial and Dina quest ticking/routing.
scripts/player.js + scripts/camera.js + scripts/view3.js - player state/actions, aiming camera and third-person toggle.
scripts/ui.js + scripts/stats-ui.js - composed player HUD/menus and character status; UI displays derived sanity cap including slap-bracelet bonus.
places/main/sim.js + scripts/lib/maze.js + scripts/lib/xmas-room.js - Level 0 layout, Christmas Area and stair-anomaly seeding.
places/level02/sim.js + scripts/lib/level02.js + scripts/lib/l02-grid.js + scripts/lib/remodel-quest.js - Level 0.2 house, crew exit, basement grid/collapse and Fresh Paint.

places/level31/sim.js + scripts/lib/level31.js + scripts/lib/level31-parts.js + scripts/l31-props-geo.js - versioned rink shell, reusable furniture geometry and modular zone dressing; scripts/player.js applies rink movement physics.
shared: scripts/lib/hub.js + scripts/lib/data/preload.yml + scripts/lib/preload-next.js - solo room IDs/names, destinations, home destinations and model proximity-preload manifest; Level 5 display labels use level5.js placards.
scripts/lib/loot.js + scripts/lib/items.js + scripts/lib/weapons.js/data/weapons.yml - common loot, containers, item definitions, rarity and weapon variants; items include roller skates.

scripts/door-geo.js + scripts/lib/door-swing.js + scripts/lib/level3-hatch.js - parametric door geometry/motion and deterministic Level 3 paired wall-hatch layout; thresholds/sign geometry shared by participating places.

scripts/lib/quest-route.js + scripts/lib/quest-mark.js + scripts/lib/quests.js - crossing graph/objectives and common quest state; dialogue data, npc-starters and npc-talk support conversations, trader choices and item grouping.
scripts/lib/data/l02-props.yml + scripts/lib/data/l02-remodel.yml + scripts/lib/l02-grid.js - Level 0.2 prop catalog, shifting partitions, lamp/paint configuration, crew dressing and reset.
scripts/lib/breakables.js + scripts/lib/data/breakables.yml - shared prop/wall material, damage, drops, wrecking and regrowth; place sims opt in with sweepProps/tickWalls.
scripts/lib/data/cow-lines.yml + scripts/lib/data/voice-cast.yml/voice-acted.yml + scripts/lib/voices.js - named performers and recorded takes for NPC bark/dialogue consumers.
scripts/lib/level31.js + scripts/lib/level31-parts.js - shared rink bounds/zones, arrivals, doors and skating model; Level 31 sim dispatches zone dressers and player movement consumes skateStep.
notableExports: scripts/lib/level31.js - H, B, RINK, ZONES, ARRIVE, DOOR, onRink, zoneAt, SKATE, skateStep; shared Level 31 geometry and skating step.
scripts/lib/level31-parts.js - layParts; calls layArcade, layFood, layRental and layShop zone builders.
scripts/lib/level31-food.js - L31_FOOD, L31_ZONE_X, l31Order, layFood; food effects, tray rule and food-court dressing.
scripts/lib/level31-arcade.js - ears, cardSlide, result, layArcade; card dispenser, usable cabinet behaviors and arcade props/NPCs.
scripts/lib/level31-rental.js + scripts/lib/level31-shop.js - layRental and layShop; Coach's booth and Dottie's gift-counter sets/NPCs.
scripts/l31-props-geo.js - geometry, collider; parametric cinema seats, curtains, benches, lockers, bins, ceiling cans and door casings selected by params.kind.
scripts/lib/rink-items.js - useGadget; implements glow, disposable camera, walkman and bracelet consumables from snack data.
scripts/lib/hub.js - HUB_ROOM, HUB_PLACE, isHubRoom, soloRoom, HOMES, LEVEL_NAMES, lastLevel, toHub, toSolo; hotel destination is per booked room.
ownership: scripts/player.js - persistent player.state progression, health/sanity, inventory/equipment, needs, combat, access, appearance, saved position, tapes, currency and homeKeep; also owns furniture counts, skates, snack gadgets and food effects.
scripts/lib/quests.js - player.state.quests, qtrack and qdone; scripts/lib/dina-quest.js advances dinaQ and owns dinaDiary/dcut/dinaLead plus legacy quest migration.
scripts/lib/remodel-quest.js - player.state.remodQ, l02got, l02paint, fresh, capnAsk and capnFailed plus Fresh Paint quest/HUD/payout/reputation.
scripts/build.js + places/level5/sim.js - player homeKeep.built or homeKeep.l5built; home11 and booked Level 5 room buckets reconstruct separately.

scripts/l5-resident.js + places/level5/sim.js - player l5room/l5home/l5until/l5key booking identity and place.state.l5rent permanent exclusive-room ledger; sim repairs keys and restores trunk ownership.
scripts/arcade-play.js owns arcade session/score and arcadeBest; smoothie-player.js owns smoothieOpen/smix/smoothieBook/smoothieBuff/sCut; UI overlays consume these states.
Enemy managers own AI and sneakTarget; scripts/lib/meg-agent.js keeps gunpoint reaction memory/dialogue/pose on NPCs; scripts/lib/critter-model.js refits appearances.

places/level31/sim.js owns place.state.v31 layout version (currently 13) and generated l31-* roots; scripts/player.js mover scratch owns transient slip cooldown/onRink while player.state.skates persists acquired skates.
flows: world.config.yaml actions → templates/player.js ordered locomotion, player/foe, swim/climb, interact, grab/kick, build, inventory, combat, social, hub, camera and quest behaviors; arcade-play.js and smoothie-player.js join their respective minigames.

world.config.yaml camera → scripts/camera.js; view3 writes player.state.tp/orbit → camera; camera writes aimPt/aimPitch → player.js ballistics and weaponAim; player.js zoneHere → scripts/lib/maze.js zone names.
world.config.yaml input actions bind kick H/L and reload R; handlers in player/combat behaviors consume action names.

scripts/routing.js requested room → scripts/lib/hub.js solo room selection; toHub/toSolo cross to hub/home and maintain roomHop/save-place state; kiosk's Level 5 home destination resolves l5-home-<internal room id>.
Fresh visit → main-menu.js; START routes to intake or Bonus, wardrobe close to intro/tutorial0; menuOpen drives menu UI and solo pause scales place time.

tutorial0 HALOGEN cut completion → scripts/lib/tut0-cut.js and scripts/lib/dina-quest.js; diary/cutscene and clue records across Level 26, Level 1, Level 3 and Gamma advance player.state.dinaQ and play recorded voices.
scripts/build.js permits building only inside home11 or permanently booked Level 5 room; placement/removal writes homeKeep.built or homeKeep.l5built, and Level 5 sim restores saved pieces.

scripts/l5-resident.js booking → player l5home/l5room and place.state.l5rent; Level 5 sim reconciles player keys/trunks; hub kiosk resolves per-room arrival and level5.js PLACARDS supplies human-facing room number.
Level 2 sim spawns l2-to-l31 → scripts/level-door.js transfers to level31#l31-from-l2; Level 31 l31-back transfers to level2#l2-from-l31; quest-route.js maps both directed crossings.

Level 31 sim reads H/B/RINK/ZONES/DOOR, rebuilds its shell and dispatches layParts under place.state.v31=13; shell furniture uses scripts/l31-props-geo.js, while food/arcade/rental/shop modules dress their zones.
scripts/player.js movement on level31 rink → skateStep(SKATE, player.state.skates, mover scratch, input/velocity); shoes slip on rink turns and owned skates roll/glide/brake.

Level 31 food clerk dialogue choices in dlg-generic.yml call l31Order via scripts/talk.js; scripts/lib/npc-talk.js reads data/snacks.yml to group consumable snacks/drinks as food for trader lists, including Dottie's rink treats.
behaviorFamilies: places/bonus mall sims/shopper/salon scripts - authored mall shops/props and simulated staff; Block Panic and Squeeze Play are separate playable counters.

scripts/lib/data/furniture.yml + build-piece.js + build.js + home reconstruction scripts - furniture-specific models/dimensions through common placement, persistence and rebuild flow; home11 and Level 5 use separate saved buckets.

scripts/door-geo.js + scripts/lib/door-swing.js and prop-interactions.js + interactive-props data + prop-part.js - parametric doors/storage parts with eased motion and legacy prop migration; Fort Surrender uses tagged paired leaves.
scripts/lib/thresholds.js + scripts/threshold-geo.js + participating place sims, alongside sign-style.js/sign-geo.js - shared crossing clues and per-place/per-id sign-board styles.
places/level01/sim.js + Zenith geometry, breach, hatch, bot and hazard scripts; places/level02/sim.js + l02-grid.js vary partitions/lights/crew/knocks/reset.
scripts/lib/meg-agent.js - per-NPC nerve/stats/weapon-driven reactions, aim, cover and recorded gunpoint barks; scripts/lib/critter-model.js refits appearances across Level 7, Bonus and Level 0.2.

Level 13 furnishing/dressing data and foe/people/tape layers vary rooms, story, encounters and residents; weapon data vary requirements/stats/loot while stats.js and weapon-look/fp-gun/vmpose supply handling and visuals.

Level 31 modular venue: sim owns shell/version and uses l31-props-geo.js for shared parametric furniture; level31-parts dispatches four zone builders, which author their own sets/NPCs and vary across food, arcade, rental and gift shop.
probableOrphans: scripts/balloon26-geo.js - procedural balloon geometry exists, while Level 26 placements/barrage use uploaded models.
scripts/hairtest-rig.js - marked temporary hair lane rig; no current references found.
art/critter-hair-tripo/fit.py.held - saved fitter copy; active fit.py is the documented build fitter.
scripts/dbg-pose.js - debug-room mannequin gallery after places/debug removal; no current placement found.
scripts/dbg-bodypad.js, scripts/debug-pad.js, scripts/lib/debug-layout.js - debug-room pads/layout after places/debug removal; no current references found.
migrationNotes: Level 31 sim now uses place.state.v31=13 and removes/rebuilds l31-* roots; keep IDs prefixed l31- and align zone coordinates, arrivals and door IDs with scripts/lib/level31.js.

Level 31 ambient/hemisphere light, fog, wall material and house-can intensities jointly set the rink read; Coach's explicit trader/survivor identity and home/post override npcState defaults by spread order.
scripts/l31-props-geo.js furniture origins are floor centres with fronts toward -Z; keep params.kind dimensions, yaw and the sim's static seat/collider setup aligned.

Skate ownership is player.state.skates and inventory token skates is weightless; slip cooldown/onRink are mover scratch, and skating checks place level31, floor height and rink bounds. SKATE.shoe and SKATE.roll tune distinct shoe-slip versus skate handling.
Level 2 plywood door reseeds under place.state.l31V=2; trigger IDs target level31#l31-from-l2 and level2#l2-from-l31. Keep both IDs aligned with quest-route.js.

Level 5 booking uses internal suite*/n*/s* IDs in player saves and place.state.l5rent; display and spoken room numbers come from level5.js PLACARDS. l5-home-* arrivals/trunk ownership match these IDs, and trunk contents including furniture reconstruct from saved state.
